blocks.html:
Although there are several helper methods in this class, the main methods used by the Medusa backend are `addDocuments`, `deleteDocument`, and `search`.
The rest of the methods are provided in case you need them for custom use cases.

---

You can use the `constructor` of your search service to access the different services in Medusa through dependency injection.

You can also use the constructor to initialize your integration with the third-party provider. For example, if you use a client to connect to the third-party provider’s APIs,
you can initialize it in the constructor and use it in other methods in the service.

Additionally, if you’re creating your search service as an external plugin to be installed on any Medusa backend and you want to access the options added for the plugin,
you can access them in the constructor. The default constructor already sets the value of the class proeprty `options_` to the passed options.

types.name: cradle
types.description: An container cradle that allows you to access other resources, such as services, in your Medusa backend.

types.name: options
types.description: If this search service is created in a plugin, the plugin's options are passed in this parameter.

types.name: isDefault
types.description: This property is used to pinpoint the default search service defined in the Medusa core. For custom search services, the `isDefault` property must be `false`.

types.name: options_
types.description: If your search service is created in a plugin, the plugin's options will be available in this property.

blocks.html: This method is used to create an index in the search engine.

types.name: indexName
types.description: The name of the index to create.

types.name: options
types.description:
Any options that may be relevant to your search service. This parameter doesn't have
any defined format as it depends on your custom implementation.

types.name: unknown
types.description: No required format of returned data, as it depends on your custom implementation.

blocks.html: This method is used to retrieve an index’s results from the search engine.

types.name: indexName
types.description: The name of the index

types.name: unknown
types.description: No required format of returned data, as it depends on your custom implementation.

blocks.html:
This method is used to add a document to an index in the search engine.

When the Medusa backend loads, it triggers indexing for all products available in the Medusa backend, which uses this method to add or update documents.
It’s also used whenever a new product is added or a product is updated.

types.name: indexName
types.description: The name of the index to add the documents to.

types.name: documents
types.description: The list of documents to add. For example, an array of entities!Product | products.

types.name: type
types.description: The type of documents being indexed. For example, `products`.

types.name: unknown
types.description: The response of saving the documents in the search engine, but there’s no required format of the response.

blocks.html: This method is used to replace existing documents in the search engine of an index with new documents.

types.name: indexName
types.description: The name of the index that the documents belong to.

types.name: documents
types.description:
The list of documents to index. For example, it can be an array of entities!Product | products.
Based on your search engine implementation, the documents should include an identification key that allows replacing the existing documents.

types.name: type
types.description: The type of documents being replaced. For example, `products`.

types.name: unknown
types.description: The response of replacing the documents in the search engine, but there’s no required format of the response.

blocks.html:
This method is used to delete a document from an index.

When a product is deleted in the Medusa backend, this method is used to delete the product from the search engine’s index.

types.name: indexName
types.description: The name of the index that the document belongs to.

types.name: document_id
types.description:
The ID of the item indexed. For example, if the deleted item is a product, then this is
the ID of the product.

types.name: unknown
types.description: The response of deleting the document in the search engine, but there’s no required format of the response.

blocks.html: This method is used to delete all documents from an index.

types.name: indexName
types.description: The index's name.

types.name: unknown
types.description: The response of deleting the documents of that index in the search engine, but there’s no required format of the response.

blocks.html:
This method is used to search through an index by a query.

In the Medusa backend, this method is used within the [Search Products API Route](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#products\_postproductssearch)
to retrieve the search results. The API route's response type is an array of items, though the item's format is not defined as it depends on the
data returned by this method.

types.name: indexName
types.description: The index's name. In the case of the Search Products API Routes, its value is `products`.

types.name: query
types.description: The search query to retrieve results for.

types.name: options
types.description:
Options that can configure the search process. The Search Products API route passes an object having the properties:

- `paginationOptions`: An object having an `offset` and `limit` properties, which are passed in the API Route's body.
- `filter`: Filters that are passed in the API Route's request body. Its format is unknown, so you can pass filters based on your search service.
- `additionalOptions`: Any other parameters that may be passed in the request's body.

types.name: unknown
types.description: The list of results. For example, an array of products.

blocks.html:
This method is used to update the settings of an index within the search service. This is useful if you want to update the index settings when the plugin options change.

For example, in the Algolia plugin, a loader, which runs when the Medusa backend loads, is used to update the settings of indices based on the plugin options.
The loader uses this method to update the settings.

types.name: indexName
types.description: The index's name to update its settings.

types.name: settings
types.description: The settings to update. Its format depends on your use case.

types.name: unknown
types.description: The response of updating the index in the search engine, but there’s no required format of the response.
